head: 648326e

reviews.name: phase17-spec-review
reviews.note: Menu items acted on herdr's focused pane while a text field had the keyboard (⌘W could close the wrong pane without a prompt), rename focus loss moved the selection back, a lone zoom stayed, focus-follows-mouse through a zoom.

reviews.name: phase17-ponytail-review
reviews.note: One pane command list instead of a placeholder copy, canZoom counted once, header parts in one place.

reviews.name: phase17-e2e-review
reviews.note: Saw a terminal go blank during the 0.2 s layout motion (frame grabs 60-90 ms apart), so item 16's hold was needed; found focus-follows-mouse missing a rename that ended under the pointer.

reviews.name: phase17-spec-review-2
reviews.note: Unflipped host pinned held terminals to the bottom, focus-follows-mouse could pull the page back to a tab after a palette pick, a moved zoomed card stayed zoomed, the round 1 zoom fix was a no-op.

reviews.name: phase17-ponytail-review-2
reviews.note: Caught the dead canZoom clause (zoom never ended) and the keyboard-card rule written four times.

reviews.name: phase17-e2e-review-2
reviews.note: Out-of-order divider sends, a leaking teardown, the missing ⌥⌘→ press and tests for the round 1 fixes.

reviews.name: phase17-spec-review-3
reviews.note: A double-click during an in-flight send was dropped, a snapshot during a drag lost the release, docs contradicted the menu check.

reviews.name: phase17-e2e-review-3
reviews.note: The focus-follows-mouse test would pass without the text-field guard.

reviews.name: phase17-spec-review-4
reviews.note: Teardown request without an id (herdr rejects it); same as the E2E reviewer.

reviews.name: phase17-e2e-review-4
reviews.note: Same teardown id as spec round 4.

notes: Phase not small: 4 rounds, all reviewers had shoulds through round 3. Slowed by a global hotkey eating ⌃⌘= (two debug runs before a one-line log showed the app never got it), pane.swap moving herdr's focus (found when a later test launched on the wrong workspace; spiked, restored in teardown), and a terminal hold on page appear that failed the first full make e2e. GUI lock about 55 min over 12 runs (10 single-test runs, 2 full).
